# Kanaky Tech

> Kanaky Tech is an AI automation and agent-development studio based in Auckland, Aotearoa (New Zealand), founded by Kevyn Wahuzue and registered in New Zealand (NZBN 9429053554017). Melanesia comes first — New Caledonia (Kanaky), Papua New Guinea, Fiji, Vanuatu and Solomon Islands — and the studio also works remotely with New Zealand, Australia, French Polynesia, Wallis and Futuna and Réunion, in French and English. The first AI opportunity audit is free.

Updated 2026-09-24.

Pricing follows local purchasing power; the work does not change with the rate. Where connectivity is uneven, AI that runs offline on the client's own hardware is a requirement, and client data stays on infrastructure the client controls.

## What Kanaky Tech does
- [AI Opportunity Audit](https://kanaky.xyz/ai-audit/): free; maps your workflows and ranks where AI saves the most time.
- [Audit Flash IA — Nouvelle-Calédonie](https://kanaky.xyz/nc/): the same free audit in French, 45 minutes by video, for businesses registered in New Caledonia.
- [AI Pilot](https://kanaky.xyz/ai-pilot/): one concrete AI tool built for your workflow in a week, one fixed price agreed on a short scope call, no retainer, and you only pay if it works.
- [Business Process Automation](https://kanaky.xyz/business-process-automation/): quotes, follow-ups, reporting, data entry, customer replies.
- [AI Agent Development](https://kanaky.xyz/ai-agents-new-caledonia/): custom AI agents grounded in a business's own data and tools.
- [Private AI Systems](https://kanaky.xyz/private-ai-systems/): AI in a controlled environment; client data never trains public models; NDA available.

## Products you can buy directly
- [AI Sales Rep](https://kanaky.xyz/marketplace/cold-outreach-machine/) — US$999 once, not a subscription. It finds the companies you describe, reads what each publishes, writes a different email for every one and sends them itself, paced inside working hours (about twenty a day); it notifies you only when a human replies. Writing runs in the cloud or locally (Ollama). Included: source code, guided installer, named licence for one entity, a 60-minute setup call, 30 days of support. Needs a separate sending domain (SPF, DKIM, DMARC); the buyer stays responsible for compliance; no results guaranteed. French: [Commercial IA](https://kanaky.xyz/machine-prospection-commerciale/) — 999 USD, about 103,000 XPF, once.
- [AI Chief of Staff](https://kanaky.xyz/ai-chief-of-staff/) — US$1,490 once, installed with you in 90 minutes: memory, a Telegram bridge and scheduled agents for an AI coding assistant you already use, on your own hardware. French: [Assistant IA personnel](https://kanaky.xyz/assistant-ia-personnel/).
- Supporting reading: [Cold email software you buy once](https://kanaky.xyz/cold-email-software-one-time-payment/) · [Self-hosted cold email](https://kanaky.xyz/self-hosted-cold-email/) · [What cold outreach actually costs](https://kanaky.xyz/blog/cold-email-subscription-vs-one-time-cost/)

## Ecosystem
- [Keou Studio](https://studio.kanaky.xyz/): product visuals, video and voice-overs from one product photo. Free, no account (bring your own API key). Open source under the MIT licence: [github.com/kanakytech/keou](https://github.com/kanakytech/keou) · [self-host](https://studio.kanaky.xyz/self-host.html) · [custom builds on request](https://studio.kanaky.xyz/custom.html). Cost per image measured on 3 September 2026: Nano Banana Pro US$0.09, Nano Banana 2 US$0.06, GPT Image 2 US$0.05. [Overview](https://kanaky.xyz/blog/keou-ai-creative-production/).
- [Dictionary of the Kanak languages](https://dictionnaire.kanaky.xyz/): free, no ads — 9 Kanak languages, 19,672 words, native-speaker audio and a retrieval-grounded AI assistant.
- [Pasifika AI](https://pasifika.ai/): a free assistant for Pacific cultures and languages.
- [Starlink Mini delivered to New Caledonia](https://starlink.kanaky.xyz/) · [Import a product from New Zealand](https://starlink.kanaky.xyz/commander-nz)
- [Formations IA](https://formations.kanaky.xyz/) (in French): [Initiation à l'IA](https://formations.kanaky.xyz/initiation.html) 9,990 XPF · [Formation Claude Code et MCP](https://formations.kanaky.xyz/claude-code.html) 19,990 XPF · [Parcours IA](https://formations.kanaky.xyz/parcours.html) 99,990 XPF. Not a registered training body (no Qualiopi, CPF or OPCO funding).

## Our position on where AI is going
[The future of AI is local and personal](https://kanaky.xyz/blog/future-of-ai-is-local-and-personal/): privacy is the precondition for useful AI, so personal, context-heavy work will move close to the person while hard reasoning stays in the cloud.
